topic: 近一年触觉数据与视觉数据联合训练的方法和进展

stopping_rule.note: Stop only when every requirement passes; source-count floors alone never establish coverage.

notes: llm dynamic expansion (high): The review is restricted to training or adapting robot representations, policies, and world models with paired visual and tactile/force data; pure tactile hardware and inference-only sensing are adjacent rather than direct evidence.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-visuotactile-joint-training
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:((visuo-tactile OR vision-tactile) AND (training OR learning)) AND all:(robot AND manipulation)
dynamic_suggestions.why: Capture papers that explicitly train on visual and tactile streams rather than merely adding a touch sensor at deployment.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-visuotactile-world-model
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:((visuo-tactile OR vision-tactile) AND world AND model) AND all:(robot OR manipulation)
dynamic_suggestions.why: Cover action-conditioned joint prediction of visual and contact futures.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-tactile-vla-grounding
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:(tactile AND (VLA OR vision-language-action) AND (grounding OR action)) AND all:robot
dynamic_suggestions.why: Find tactile supervision injected into VLA representations or action experts.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-tactile-distillation
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:(tactile AND distillation AND (vision OR VLA)) AND all:(robot OR manipulation)
dynamic_suggestions.why: Cover training-time tactile supervision that is distilled into a deployable visual policy.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-contact-gated-asymmetric-fusion
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:(tactile AND (gated OR asymmetric) AND fusion) AND all:(robot OR manipulation)
dynamic_suggestions.why: Capture selective fusion intended to prevent tactile inputs from corrupting visual dynamics.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-visuotactile-reflex-control
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:((visuo-tactile OR vision-tactile) AND (reflex OR high-frequency OR residual)) AND all:(robot AND control)
dynamic_suggestions.why: Cover slow visual planning plus fast tactile residual correction in closed loop.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-visuotactile-benchmark-generalization
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:((visuo-tactile OR touch-vision) AND (benchmark OR dataset OR generalization)) AND all:robot
dynamic_suggestions.why: Cover paired-data scale, contact-sequence leakage, held-out materials, and closed-loop evaluation boundaries.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-missing-tactile-negative-transfer
dynamic_suggestions.query: all:(tactile AND (missing-modality OR negative-transfer OR contamination)) AND all:(robot AND manipulation)
dynamic_suggestions.why: Search counterevidence on sensor absence, unstructured fusion, and deployment mismatch.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-visuotactile-browser
dynamic_suggestions.query: site:arxiv.org/abs (visuo-tactile OR vision-tactile) robot manipulation world model VLA
dynamic_suggestions.why: Recover named methods missed by arXiv metadata wording.

dynamic_suggestions.label: dynamic-latest-visuotactile-calibration
dynamic_suggestions.why: Calibrate July 2026 terminology and check the end of the requested window.

calibration_notes: arxiv calibration (high): Representation-aligned tactile grounding applies future-touch supervision at intermediate action-expert features.
arxiv calibration (high): HapticVLA distills training-time tactile information into a vision/state policy that does not require touch at deployment.
arxiv calibration (high): OmniVTA combines a two-stream visuo-tactile world model with a contact-aware policy and a 60 Hz tactile reflex controller.
arxiv calibration (high): RCT exposes contact-sequence leakage and held-out-material failure in touch-vision-language representation learning.
